projects.name: FlyerPro AI
projects.tagline: AI-powered flyer & promo design, in seconds.
projects.overview: FlyerPro AI turns a plain-language prompt into polished flyers, posters and promo graphics. Users describe their offer — price, date, vibe — and get an on-brand design ready to print or post.
projects.problem: Small businesses, event promoters and creators can't afford a designer for every little promotion, and template builders still leave the design work — layout, hierarchy, colour — to them. Most people give up and ship a messy graphic.
features: Prompt-to-flyer generation with layout and hierarchy baked in
Editable templates for print sizes and social formats
On-brand styling from a user's logo and colour palette
Instant export to PNG, PDF and social-ready formats
Thumbnail and A/B variant generation for campaigns
projects.priceNote: Full product + codebase + assets. Right to brand and scale included.

projects.name: Zo Ride
projects.tagline: Modern, reliable ride-hailing for African cities.
projects.overview: Zo Ride is a ride-hailing platform designed around the realities of African urban transport — flexible pricing, motorbike options, cash support and low-data mode. Driver and rider apps, plus a dispatch dashboard.
projects.problem: Existing ride-hailing apps are built for global markets and miss local needs: motorbikes, cash payments, shared rides and unreliable connectivity. Riders end up with impractical options and drivers lose earnings.
projects.priceNote: Codebase, product design and roadmap. Positioned for an operator or seed-stage team.

projects.name: Sua — Study Planner
projects.tagline: A student productivity app that actually sticks.
projects.overview: Sua is a study-planning app that breaks semesters into daily, achievable sessions. Built for students who struggle with big workloads, it keeps plans realistic and progress visible.
projects.problem: Students over-plan and under-revise. Classic planners set them up to fail with unachievable schedules, and motivation dies when progress is invisible.
